subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should maintainers accept this bundled `github-copilot` auth/config boundary: `device-enterprise`, `COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN`, `githubDomain`, and fail-closed `*.ghe.com` token routing?
rationale: The patch looks correct and proven, but it intentionally changes OAuth token-exchange host selection and adds user-facing auth/config surface, which is an owner/security boundary decision rather than a purely mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve and land this boundary
options.body: Accept the narrow provider-owned GHE data-residency surface and land after normal exact-head merge validation and stale review cleanup.

options.title: Narrow to config-only
options.body: Keep tenant routing but remove or defer the interactive `device-enterprise` wizard choice if maintainers want less onboarding surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Close or pause the PR if maintainers decide GHE data-residency Copilot should not be bundled despite the existing-provider fit.

recommendation.title: Approve and land this boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow provider-owned GHE data-residency surface and land after normal exact-head merge validation and stale review cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion cites this owner direction for keeping the work in the existing Copilot provider, making them the best available owner for the acceptance call.
